positions.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developer for the Cloud and Containers teams.

Contributor to the Security Profiles Operator, a project under the Kubernetes Node Special Interest Group. Contributed the SeccompProfile Custom Resource Definition to the Security Profiles Operator, replacing the ConfigMap-based controller with a higher-level user-friendly interface to create and apply custom seccomp profiles on Kubernetes hosts. Primary maintainer of the rancher-selinux RPM which provides policies to allow Rancher and related applications to run securely on SELinux-enabled systems.
Implemented an operator-based plugin for Rancher to support creating and importing GKE and AKS clusters in Rancher and keep the cluster configuration safely synchronized between Rancher and the hosted Kubernetes providers. Restructured the way requests are proxied to Rancher-managed clusters to prevent a privilege escalation.

Core contributor to Keystone, the OpenStack Identity project. Designed and implemented Application Credentials in Keystone, which enabled users to delegate fine-grained API access to applications with easily rotatable keys. Contributed detailed documentation on federated identity protocols SAML2.0 and OpenID Connect as well as Keystone's SAML2.0-based Keystone-to-Keystone cloud federation model.
As Project Team Lead (2019), oversaw the reformation of Keystone's RBAC model to work securely and intuitively in both system-wide and tenant-specific scopes to properly embrace a multitenant model.
As team lead, helped design and oversaw the implementation of the Keystone Limits API which would allow OpenStack components such as Compute, Image, or Block Storage to centrally define resource quota limits and use a common framework to compute quota usage. Maintained RPM packages for every OpenStack component for SUSE Cloud. Maintained Crowbar, the Chef-based OpenStack lifecycle manager for SUSE Cloud, and updated it for new releases of OpenStack.

positions.title: Cloud Developer
positions.description:
Core reviewer and Project Team Lead for OpenStack keystone. Lead a team of 5-10 contributors, which included coordinating releases, maintaining stable branches, and project management. Lead the design and implementation of Application Credentials for keystone which enhanced the security and user experience of developing cloud applications. Instrumented the formation of a cross-project team to drive enhancements to the RBAC implementation for OpenStack with the goal of making policy management easier to operate and more secure across every OpenStack service. Rapidly implemented fixes for several critical security vulnerabilities upon being reported. Mentored interns and junior developers toward becoming valuable contributors. Gave presentations on project updates, new project features and complex keystone topics such as identity federation.

Core reviewer for the OpenStack RPM-Packaging project. Created and maintained vendor-agnostic RPM package templates for OpenStack projects. Maintained tooling to support the unification of downstream RPM packaging efforts. Maintained packages of OpenStack projects for openSUSE and SLES.

Served on the OpenStack Technical Committee 2017-2018. Represented the interests of the OpenStack community by voting on governance proposals and new project adoptions and participating in community discussions.

Contributed to and supported SUSE OpenStack Cloud. Worked as one of the leading developers on ensuring smooth integration with the latest OpenStack releases. Worked closely with the customer support team to address questions, resolve bugs and implement features that were essential to customers. Traveled to provide onsite customer support to an influential customer. Supported the internal cloud deployment by maintaining an out-of-tree keystone plugin to make keystone role assignments easier to maintain with configuration management tooling. Gave presentations and maintained internal documentation on using and contributing to SOC.

positions.title: OpenStack Engineer
positions.description:
Core reviewer on the puppet modules subteam on the OpenStack Infrastructure team. Championed the adoption of functional testing for the puppet modules. Planned, coordinated and completed the migration from puppet 3 to puppet 4.

Chief shepherd for the Infra Cloud project, in which the OpenStack Infrastructure team operated a cloud running on donated hardware that served to provide testing infrastructure to supplement the compute resources donated by public cloud providers.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Core reviewer on the Puppet-OpenStack project. Lead weekly community meetings and contributors' design session. Drove the adoption of keystone v3 and python-openstackclient in the puppet modules. Campaigned for and achieved adoption of the Puppet-OpenStack project as the first configuration management project to be adopted in OpenStack governance under the "big tent".

Maintained Puppet Labs Puppet Forge modules and collaborated with public contributors. Managed releases for both the Puppet-OpenStack and Puppet Labs modules.

positions.title: Engineering Intern - Forge Modules Team
positions.description: Created an open source Ruby utility (Modulesync) to simplify handling boilerplate code in puppet module development. Contributed to the StackForge OpenStack puppet modules, including implementing database creation resources in a library module. Improved the supportability of Puppet Enterprise by enhancing the support data collection tool.

company.name: Computer Science Department of Portland State University

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Used the JVT's multiview coding reference software, JMVC, to encode raw video streams as H.264 multiview streams. Analyzed and represented data with GNUPlot. Added functionality to the encoder, namely the ability to print motion vectors in a human readable form to a file specified by the user's configuration file (https://github.com/cmurphy/JMVC).

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
Tutored lower-division computer science students in C and C++, programming concepts, and theoretical computer science topics. Lead workshops on using Linux and programming utilities such as make, gdb, and valgrind.

Promoted to tutor coordinator in June 2012. Oversaw a team of 6-8 computer science tutors. Coordinated with department heads and instructors to bring relevant services to computer science students. Hired tutors. Managed and updated the tutor website. Oversaw the help IRC channel.

positions.title: Web Developer / Administrative Assistant
positions.description: Developed and maintained the website, managed social media outlets, advertised events, performed miscellaneous administrative tasks, created and managed the budget, prepared invoices for services.

positions.title: Audio Visual Event Technician
positions.description: Supported audio visual equipment for campus events.

company.name: Computer Action Team of Portland State University

positions.title: Unix/Linux Systems Administrator
positions.description: Assisted with the deployment and maintenance of over 200 Linux and Unix desktops and servers. Used Puppet to configure and update Linux and Unix systems. Developed and maintained a PHP application for authenticating students and faculty against the Microsoft Dreamspark API, including patching the application after PHP upgrades. Wrote bash scripts to automate tasks and system monitoring. Co-wrote and published on the Puppet Labs forge a Puppet module for Collectd and several Collectd plugins. Gave lectures on Unix/Linux, web technologies, database administration, and Puppet. Helped initiate and design training materials for system administration workshops.

positions.title: Videographer
positions.description: Recorded and edited Friday-night lectures for the Braindump program and promotional videos for the College of Engineering using Final Cut Pro.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Redesigned the application's notification system to accommodate changes in the application's
structure. Updated the invoicing system to reflect changes in the Terms of Service. Gained experience with the ruby language and the ruby on rails framework.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description: Implemented monitoring and analytics in the various Elemental products using Collectd, AMQP, Ruby on Rails, and Javascript with D3. Developed a prototype for video bandwidth reduction using Apache Traffic Server and Elemental transcoding products, involving writing a plugin for Apache Traffic Server in C++ that used AMQP and MySQL.
